properties.description: One row per customer with basic profile fields plus order-derived facts: first and most recent order date, order count, and lifetime value.
Date (UTC) of the customer's first order. NULL when the customer has placed no orders.
Date (UTC) of the customer's most recent order. NULL when the customer has placed no orders.
Count of orders placed by the customer. NULL, not 0, when the customer has placed no orders.
Total value (AUD) of all payments across the customer's orders. NULL when the customer has no orders or no payments recorded.
One row per order with the order's status and payment amounts split by payment method, plus the order total.
Foreign key to customers.customer_id. Every order belongs to an existing customer.
Date (UTC) that the order was placed.

Order lifecycle status. One of placed (not yet left the warehouse), shipped (in transit to the customer), completed (received by the customer), return_pending (return requested, not yet back at the warehouse), returned (returned and received at the warehouse).
Amount of the order (AUD) paid by credit card. 0 when that method was not used.
Amount of the order (AUD) paid by coupon. 0 when that method was not used.
Amount of the order (AUD) paid by bank transfer. 0 when that method was not used.
Amount of the order (AUD) paid by gift card. 0 when that method was not used.
Total amount (AUD) of the order. Equals the sum of credit_card_amount, coupon_amount, bank_transfer_amount and gift_card_amount.
